steps.body: Labels skip numbers, but the line never does: between 40 and 50 live 41 through 49, with 45 sitting exactly halfway.
steps.narration: Labels skip numbers, but the line never does: between 40 and 50 live 41 through 49, with 45 sitting exactly halfway.

widget.prompt: March into the gap: from 40, five one-hops toward the halfway point.

commonLandings.feedback: That leapt the WHOLE gap — halfway stops at five of the ten.

widget.missFeedback: Each hop is 1, going forward. From 40, 5 hops land on 45.
widget.successFeedback: 45 — five small steps deep, exactly halfway to 50.

predict.prompt: Between marks 60 and 70, does 64 exist on the line?
predict.reveal: The line holds every number; labels are a courtesy, not a boundary.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2l between.
invariants: Position on the line IS the number: equal jumps cover equal amounts, and a journey's landing depends only on start, jump size, and direction for g2l between.
misconceptions: Treating marks as decoration — unequal spacing, jumps of the wrong size, or reading a start mark as a landing.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: Which change — start, jump size, or direction — would move the landing, and which would leave it alone?

options.label: The 50 mark
options.feedback: Count both distances: 43 back to 40 is 3 hops, but 43 up to 50 is 7 hops.

options.label: The 45 mark
options.feedback: 45 is the halfway number, not a labeled mark — and 43 does not sit at 45 anyway.

options.label: Both marks are equally close
options.feedback: Only 45 sits the same distance from both marks; 43 splits the gap 3-and-7, not evenly.

options.label: The 40 mark
options.feedback: Correct — 43 sits 3 hops from 40 but 7 hops from 50, so the 40 mark is closer.
